$about: Machine-readable contract for tests/scenarios/*.json, enforced by
tests/p00/test_scenarios.gd. The consumer is game/core/harness.gd, which
reads name, seed, ticks, sample_every, script and shots and ignores the
rest. The rest is here so tools/ and critics have something to read.
A scenario is a script of Sim.submit_command payloads on a timeline. It is
the only way a headless run makes anything happen, so the command vocabulary
below is a contract between [P00] and the part that owns each system.
Files starting with an underscore are not scenarios.

required.name: string, must equal the file basename
required.seed: int, the world seed handed to Sim.create_world
required.ticks: int >= 1, simulation ticks to run at 20 Hz

optional.description: string, why this scenario exists and what to read off it
optional.tags: array of string: fast | gate | reference | balance | perf | determinism | visual | long
optional.shots: array of {tick, name}, only used by tools/run_visual.sh
optional.expects: dict of thresholds tools/ assert against

script_entry.tick: int, 1 <= tick <= scenario.ticks. Tick 0 never fires: the harness loop starts at 1.

required.system: string, must be one of scenario_systems below; Sim routes on it
required.op: string, the verb the owning system switches on

command.note: Everything else is op-specific. Vector2i cannot be expressed in JSON, so cells travel as [x, y] and are converted by the receiving system.
command.region_encoding: from: [x, y], to: [x, y] — inclusive corners, any order

expects.max_errors: int, allowed entries in state.json.errors (Bus.alert_raised severity >= 2)
expects.min_ticks_per_second: float, hard floor for tools/perf.sh; below this the build fails
expects.target_ticks_per_second: float, soft target; below this tools/perf.sh warns

$note: Verified against the shipped systems where they exist, proposed where the
part has not landed yet. An unknown system is a Log.warn from Sim and an
unknown op is a refusal from the system, so a scenario written ahead of a
part degrades to a no-op instead of breaking the run.

content_hint.$note: Building kinds the scenarios reference. game/content/buildings/ is [P11]'s to fill; tests/p00/test_scenarios.gd fails if none of these ever resolve once buildings exist.
